title: Where Did the Blue Umbrellas Go?
summaryZh: 五把藍傘同時不見，鄰居立刻懷疑有人偷走它們；Maya 追查借用線索後，發現共享計畫真正缺少的是更清楚的溝通方式。

sentences.text: One week later, the Blue Umbrella Plan had twelve umbrellas, each marked with a blue ribbon and a number.
sentences.zh: 一週後，藍傘共享計畫已有十二把傘，每一把都繫著藍絲帶並標上編號。

sentences.text: A new sign asked borrowers to return them to the cafe basket by the next day, even if the weather was clear.
sentences.zh: 新告示請借用者在隔天前把傘歸還到咖啡店的籃子裡，即使天氣已經放晴也一樣。

sentences.text: Maya visited every afternoon after class and counted the umbrellas with Ms. Lin using a simple paper chart.
sentences.zh: Maya 每天下課後都會過來，和林女士用一張簡單的紙本表格清點雨傘。

sentences.text: Most came back quickly, and some returned with short notes or small repairs from thankful borrowers.
sentences.zh: 大多數的傘很快就回來了，有些還帶著借用者出於感謝而寫的短箋或做的小修補。

sentences.text: On Friday, however, only seven umbrellas stood in the basket after the sky became clear.
sentences.zh: 然而到了星期五，天空放晴後，籃子裡卻只立著七把傘。

sentences.text: Five were missing, and no one had called the phone number on the sign that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 有五把傘不見了，而且那天下午沒有人撥打告示上的電話號碼。

sentences.text: Two neighbors said the umbrellas were probably stolen and advised Ms. Lin to stop the plan before more disappeared.
sentences.zh: 兩位鄰居說那些傘很可能被偷了，還勸林女士在更多傘消失前停止計畫。

sentences.text: Maya felt worried, but she did not want to blame anyone or break the promise of trust before learning what had happened.
sentences.zh: Maya 很擔心，但在弄清楚事情經過前，她不想責怪任何人，也不想破壞信任的承諾。

sentences.text: She wrote the five missing numbers in her notebook and checked when each umbrella left.
sentences.zh: 她把五個遺失的編號寫進筆記本，並查看每把傘是在何時被借走。

sentences.text: Three had gone with families from the nearby library, while two were borrowed by library volunteers.
sentences.zh: 其中三把被附近圖書館的家庭借走，另外兩把則由圖書館志工借用。

sentences.text: Maya walked to the library and asked Noah, a young volunteer, whether he knew those people.
sentences.zh: Maya 走到圖書館，詢問年輕志工 Noah 是否認識那些人。

sentences.text: Noah remembered a sudden shower during the children's reading hour on Wednesday, just before closing time.
sentences.zh: Noah 想起星期三兒童閱讀時間快結束時，曾突然下起一場陣雨。

sentences.text: Several older visitors, including Mr. Chen, and two parents with young children were waiting at the entrance.
sentences.zh: 包括陳先生在內的幾位年長訪客，以及兩位帶著年幼孩子的家長，當時都在入口處等待。

sentences.text: The volunteers used the blue umbrellas to walk them home in small groups because many lived only a few streets away.
sentences.zh: 由於許多人只住在幾條街外，志工便用藍傘分成小組陪他們走回家。

sentences.text: Afterward, Noah placed all five umbrellas in the library's own umbrella stand.
sentences.zh: 之後，Noah 把五把傘全放進圖書館自己的傘架。

sentences.text: He had planned to return them after work, but another volunteer moved them into a locked supply room.
sentences.zh: 他原本打算下班後歸還，但另一名志工把它們移進了上鎖的儲藏室。

sentences.text: Noah showed Maya a note that he had left on the library notice board for Ms. Lin.
sentences.zh: Noah 拿給 Maya 看一張留在圖書館公告欄、原本要給林女士的字條。

sentences.text: Maya laughed with relief because the umbrellas were not stolen, yet the confusion was still a real problem.
sentences.zh: Maya 放心地笑了，因為雨傘並沒有被偷，但這場混亂仍是真正需要解決的問題。

sentences.text: The cafe sign named only one return place, and it did not explain what to do after closing.
sentences.zh: 咖啡店的告示只列出一個歸還地點，也沒有說明打烊後該怎麼做。

sentences.text: Noah had assumed a public library was a safe return point, but Ms. Lin never saw his note.
sentences.zh: Noah 原以為公共圖書館是安全的歸還地點，但林女士從未看到他的字條。

sentences.text: Maya realized that the project had grown beyond one basket and one person's memory.
sentences.zh: Maya 意識到，這項計畫已經大到不能只依靠一個籃子和一個人的記憶。

sentences.text: They carried the five umbrellas back, and the neighbors apologized for making a quick judgment.
sentences.zh: 他們把五把傘帶回去，而鄰居也為自己太快下判斷而道歉。

sentences.text: Ms. Lin thanked Noah for helping older visitors instead of scolding him about the delay.
sentences.zh: 林女士感謝 Noah 幫助年長訪客，而沒有因為延遲歸還責備他。

sentences.text: She said a sharing plan needed clear directions as much as it needed honest people.
sentences.zh: 她說，共享計畫既需要誠實的人，也同樣需要清楚的指示。

sentences.text: That evening, Maya drew a simple map with return boxes at the cafe, library, and bus station.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，Maya 畫了一張簡單的地圖，標出咖啡店、圖書館和公車站的歸還箱。

sentences.text: Each box received the same blue sign, phone number, and list of the other locations.
sentences.zh: 每個箱子都貼上相同的藍色標誌、電話號碼和其他地點的清單。

sentences.text: Noah asked library volunteers to check their box every evening and send Maya a short message.
sentences.zh: Noah 請圖書館志工每晚檢查歸還箱，並傳一則簡短訊息給 Maya。

sentences.text: The neighbors offered to build wooden covers so returned umbrellas would stay dry overnight.
sentences.zh: 鄰居主動提出製作木製遮蓋，讓歸還的雨傘能在夜裡保持乾燥。

sentences.text: By Sunday, every missing umbrella was back, and three useful return points were ready.
sentences.zh: 到了星期日，所有不見的傘都回來了，三個實用的歸還點也準備就緒。

sentences.text: Maya crossed out the word "missing" in her notebook and wrote, "Found through better communication."
sentences.zh: Maya 劃掉筆記本裡的「遺失」，改寫成：「透過更好的溝通找到了。」

questions.q: Why did the library volunteers use the blue umbrellas?
options: To test a new umbrella stand

questions.q: Where had the five umbrellas been moved?
options: Into a locked library supply room

questions.q: How did Maya improve the return system?
options: She created three clearly marked return points
